content.title: Gameplay Engineering
content.description: Projects that I worked on for clients as a contractor and launched by them

items.title: Exosky
items.objective: Create a realistic flight simulation that is performant and as close to real life as possible
items.delivered: Created a flight simulation in Unity that is easy for the client to extend. Easy to mod by players and worked with more than 16 planes at the same time at more than 60 FPS on a 4th generation core i5 CPU (a CPU from 2013).
items.subtitle: Aerodynamics, Physics Programming & Engine Optimization
work_done: Implemented and refined the core flight-simulation equations together with a flight engineer.
Managed the git repository and reviewed code from 3 other programmers to ensure code quality was maintained and functional.
Integrated F-MOD into the game for better SFX in general
Created a modding system that allowed users to edit and add completely custom airplanes into the game, without the need to even restart the game.

items.title: SluttyBass
items.objective: Create an advergame for a musician album under 3 weeks.
items.delivered: Created an action platformer using Corgi Engine.
items.subtitle: State Machine Architecture & Modular AI Systems
work_done: Managed the git repository and reviewed code from 5 other programmers to ensure code quality was maintained and functional.
Managed and reviewed tasks related to coding.
Created AI for bosses and enemies.
Imported and implemented animations made by artists.
Created an iPhone build without a Mac device, created purely with GitHub Actions using Fastly (to handle code signage) and the MacOs hosted runner.

content.title: Gameplay Prototypes
content.description: Projects that I worked on very specific things but are not full games

items.title: Multiplayer Building Game
items.subtitle: Server-Authoritative Netcode & NPC Decision Trees
work_done: Created a multiplayer system where multiple people could build in the same town.
Made a voting system where players could vote on what the NPCs would prioritize in building and doing.
Created a building system where players could place buildings if the town had the available resources in storage buildings.
Created an AI system where NPCs could automatically pathfind where resources are stored and moved to where they could build.
Used LimboAI to make a decision tree where NPCs controlled themselves based on the priority system.
Created a full authoritative dedicated server made with C# and JavaScript with database access.

content.title: NDA projects

items.title: Digital Twin
items.objective: Create a clone of a real-life building and create a virtual copy where employees from a large energy company could log in and perform general tasks
items.subtitle: What I did in the project
work_done: Managed the git repository and reviewed code from 3 other programmers to make sure the code quality maintained consistent and functional.
Created VR system using VR Interaction Framework to be used with Oculus Quest 2
Made sure the project worked with and without VR with the same codebase, allowing it to be functional even on the web by simply exporting to different platforms.

items.title: VR showcase
items.objective: Update an older project to add further features to it, it was made using Meta XR SDK for Unity
items.subtitle: What I did in the project
work_done: Managed the git repository and reviewed code from 3 other programmers to make sure the code quality was maintained consistently and functionally.
Maintained existing codebase by fixing bugs.
Created an interactive tutorial on how the showcase worked, focused on people that never used VR before.

items.title: Physics and Procedural Game
items.objective: Create a 2D game from scratch with procedural level generation and a physics-based character controller.
items.subtitle: What I did in the project
work_done: Worked on pathfinding of a flying enemy controlled by physics.
Created a physics-based flying character controller.
Created a procedural level generator utilizing TileMapLayers.
